name: multi-tenant-admin-system
description: Frontend checks for the multi-tenant administrative management system.

scripts.check:js: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process'),path=require('path');let failed=false;function walk(d){for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d)){const p=path.join(d,f);if(fs.statSync(p).isDirectory())walk(p);else if(p.endsWith('.js')){const r=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,['--check',p],{stdio:'inherit'});if(r.status)failed=true;}}}walk('assets/js');process.exit(failed?1:0)"
scripts.test:ai-epic8: npm run test:ai-conversation && npm run test:ai-operation-center
scripts.test:ai-epic6: npm run test:ai-household-tool && npm run test:ai-resident-tool && npm run test:ai-statistics-tool && npm run test:ai-runtime-tools && npm run test:ai-tool-api
scripts.test:ai-epic7: npm run test:ai-tool-orchestrator && npm run test:ai-tool-api
